ideas.title: Following the Money in the Feeding Our Future Investigation
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial dealings of Feeding Our Future and look for any potential wrongdoing.
questions: What were the financial dealings of Feeding Our Future?
ideas.insight: The fact that 2 defendants have entered guilty pleas suggests that there may be significant wrongdoing in the Feeding Our Future case. A financial investigation could uncover more information about the extent of the wrongdoing and who was involved.
